name: Worst Possible Idea
deliverable: De-inhibited concept space built by surfacing terrible alternatives

steps.text: Set the challenge, then invert it: ask for the worst possible way to handle it, the more useless the better.
Give a short timed round where people write or call out deliberately terrible ideas without defending them.
Read the worst ideas aloud and let the room laugh; the point is to lower the cost of saying something.
For each bad idea, ask what requirement it insults, then write the opposite or the fix it implies.
Keep the strongest flips and drop the jokes that carry no requirement.

failure: Half-working looks like a comedy set that ends in laughter: the bad ideas are never mined, so the room leaves with jokes instead of requirements.
intervention: For each joke, ask what real need it insults, then write the requirement that need implies and keep only what survives the flip.
provenance: Steps written for this deck from the method's public definition; the source has no protocol.

origin.note: A warm-up used in ideation workshops; no origin given in the source.
